title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs a concert built around Dvorak's popular symphony From the New World, which draws on African American music that Dvorak urged American composers to use. The program also includes Adolphus Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra and Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with violinist Fiona Shea, and it showcases the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. Tickets are sold through HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
